## ErosMax H3 v1 - Simple two-pass workflow
One optional starting image, two-pass generation and RTX super-resolution. This simple version does not include continuation, additional references, RefMods or RTX Frame Interpolation; use the advanced workflow for those features.

### Generate a video
1. Select your **H3 Turbo checkpoint, text encoder and video/audio VAEs**. Keep the text encoder type set to **minimax**.
2. In **Prompt**, describe the subject, scene, action, camera and sound/dialogue.
3. Enable **Starting image** and choose the opening frame, or bypass the loader for text-to-video. It anchors **frame 0 in both passes** and remains accessible as `<Picture 1>`. Starting-frame guidance follows the loader's bypass state automatically.
4. Choose first-pass resolution, final target megapixels and duration, then generate. Use **Preview ON** to test the first pass; switch it **OFF** for the complete two-pass result.

### Quality: options beyond the baseline
The conservative defaults suit a wide range of hardware. When your machine allows:

- **Resolution:** try 0.4 or 0.5 MP for pass 1; refinement can reach 1.2, 1.5 MP or more.
- **Sparsity:** bypassing Sparse improves ErosMax v1 final quality at a cost in time and memory; the impact varies by scene and sampler/scheduler pair.
- **Sampling:** there is no best combination for every scene. ErosMax supports euler, er_sde, res_multistep, LCM and possibly others; LCM tends to give the best audio at the expense of motion and image fidelity. Schedulers simple, sgm_uniform, beta and beta57 / beta_57 (the name depends on the installed node pack) can work in different combinations.
- **Steps:** more steps in either pass may improve quality; extra first-pass steps can add detail and improve audio, but gains diminish above 10–12 and more can backfire. Depending on the scene/prompt, this may allow gentler refinement, e.g. denoise 0.20 and perhaps 2 steps.

Start from the working configuration and change one setting at a time when comparing results.

### Sampling and resolution
The workflow includes defaults tailored to the latest ErosMax release. You can modify them to suit your scene, preferences and hardware.

- **Selector First LowRes Pass:** sets aspect ratio and first-pass resolution; keep the dimension multiple at **32**.
- **Final Target Megapixels:** sets the second-pass resolution before RTX super-resolution.
- **Duration in secs — Preview + Full:** sets the requested length for both modes. H3 rounds to supported frame counts, so the result may be slightly longer.

The first pass creates the video at lower resolution; latent upscaling increases its size before the second pass refines it. Higher resolutions, longer videos and more steps require more processing and memory.

### Preview, cache reuse and audio
**Preview ON** saves only pass 1; **OFF** adds latent upscaling/refinement. RTX super-resolution applies to both. Audio always comes from **pass 1**, including Full mode; there is no audio selector.

To reuse a cached first-pass result, switch Preview ON to OFF with a **fixed seed** and unchanged prompt, reference, duration, first-pass resolution, model, sampling and conditioning. Full mode can proceed directly to upscaling/refinement **if ComfyUI still holds the cached result**. Seed **-1** randomizes; use a fixed seed for comparisons. With the starting-image loader enabled, also keep **Final Target Megapixels** unchanged because it controls the shared image preprocessing.

### Optional LoRAs
Use **H3 Power LoRA Stack** for all LoRAs; enable the desired rows and adjust their strengths. **Realism Slider** and **Vibrant Slider** start **OFF**, with download hints. Vibrant also supports negative strengths and values above 1. Realism Slider, like optional grain, may give a more realistic look.

Add Turbo LoRAs here too, preferably first. Current ErosMax releases usually embed Turbo; another is normally unnecessary unless you change checkpoint.

#### TenStrip's adapted LoRAs
The stack also includes TenStrip's adapted LoRAs, disabled by default. For manual downloads, visit [TenStrip's LoRA repository](https://huggingface.co/TenStrip/MMH3_Sulphur3Eros_Loras-MLP-energy-patches) and place the files in `ComfyUI/models/loras/` before enabling them.

### Automatic starting-frame guidance
The starting image is injected as guidance conditioning in both sampling passes to anchor the opening frame.

### RTX super-resolution
**RTX Video Super Resolution** adds resolution after decoding: default **1.3x**, with decent quality possible even at **2x**. Bypass it to keep the decoded resolution.

### Saving and encoder quality
Generation and export are fixed at **24 FPS**.

Set filenames/folders in the **Full Resolution / Preview** prefix boxes, relative to ComfyUI's output directory. The final **Save Video** writes MP4.

**Output saving quality — encoder preset** controls the H.264 encoder's speed/compression tradeoff. Leave the selector active. Slower presets take more time for better compression efficiency and can improve MP4 quality; faster presets may produce larger files and worse quality.

### Optional output grain
Requires [Lokken VideoTools](https://registry.comfy.org/nodes/lokken-videotools), available in Manager; install and restart ComfyUI. Keep **Output film grain strength — 0 = OFF** active: **0** disables grain; adjust in **0.001** steps. Start low; **0.005–0.010** is recommended. Do not bypass the strength control.

### LBH 2D latent upscaler: installation
Install/update the [official LBH pack](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler), then restart ComfyUI. It must include the new 2D sharpness/chunking controls; older versions may be incompatible. If absent from Manager search, use **Install via Git URL** with the linked repository URL where available, or clone it into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`. Automatic missing-node installation is not guaranteed.

Download [`minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors`](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/resolve/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors) to `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`; the same download hint is attached to the upscaler. **LBH H3 2D learned latent upscale** is preconfigured and collapsed inside the generation subgraph to preserve the layout.

### Decode order and optional VRAM release
Leave KJNodes **Wait for video/RTX - decode audio last** active. **Free VRAM after video processing** (below sparsity) defaults **OFF**. ON clears caches, unloads models and runs garbage collection after video/RTX processing, before audio decoding. ComfyUI's cached first-pass results remain available; unloaded models may need reloading.
